findings.text: offer_products: Seven verticals: residential plots; flats and houses; commercial; industrial; agricultural land; rentals and leasing; investment research
location: Jammu, J&K; later Samba, Kathua, Katra if the business can support it
market: Jammu Master Plan 2032 expands the planning area from 112 to 777.84 sq km (351 villages added); JKRERA says only registered agents may market registered projects.
personas: Hypotheses: transferred professional (rental demand), absentee owner (rental supply), first-home family, plot builder / NRI buyer, colony developer. To be tested on first 50 enquiries.

competitors: Snapshot of one portal page (RealEstateIndia, Sainik Colony): 26 dealers listed; largest visible stock: Bhavani Realtors (9 sale, 67 rent), Shubhdeep Realtor (31 sale, 10 rent), Bali Property (29 sale, 6 rent), Verma Properties (23 sale, 13 rent). Not an audit of any firm's site, reviews or socials.

recommendations: Verify each stored competitor on its live Google Business Profile, website and Instagram; the stored snapshot is not an audit.
Live web research needs an AI/search provider attached to the Research agent (not configured in the app yet): until then this output is a gap-and-plan report only.
